SELECT sub.cus_id AS organizationId, customers.customer_code AS organizationCode, customers.name AS organizationName, sub.total_invoice AS totalInvoice, sub.total_amount AS totalAmount FROM ( SELECT cus_id, SUM(total_amount) AS total_amount, SUM(total_invoice) AS total_invoice FROM ( SELECT 'Invoice' AS mod_type, invoice.customer_id AS cus_id, SUM(invoice_detail.total_price - invoice_detail.discount_amount) AS total_amount, 1 AS total_invoice FROM sales_orders AS invoice INNER JOIN sales_order_details AS invoice_detail ON invoice.id = invoice_detail.sales_order_id
GROUP BY invoice.id, invoice.customer_id
UNION ALL

GROUP BY invoice.id, invoice.customer_id ) AS inner_sub GROUP BY cus_id HAVING total_invoice > 0 AND total_amount > 0 ) AS sub INNER JOIN customers ON sub.cus_id = customers.id ORDER BY
sub.total_amount DESC
sub.total_amount ASC
,
sub.cus_id DESC
sub.cus_id ASC
